_comments.Mode: Must be 'Entitlements' to run the licensing export path. Leave this file as-is; use MDC_Params.json / MCSB_Params.json for the recommendation exports.
_comments.DefenderPlansCSVFileName: Base name for the Defender for Cloud plans CSV. A timestamp is appended automatically. Columns: PlanName, SubPlan, PricingTier, Enabled, Scope (Scope = subscription ID).
_comments.LicenseInventoryCSVFileName: Base name for the Microsoft 365 license inventory CSV. A timestamp is appended automatically. Columns: SkuPartNumber, ProductName, AssignedUnits, Owned.
_comments.SubscriptionIds: Comma-separated subscription IDs or '*' for all available subscriptions in the selected tenant. Defender plans are read from every listed subscription; the M365 license inventory is tenant-wide regardless of this list.
_comments.ExportDefenderPlans: Default true. Set to false to skip the Defender for Cloud plans export.
_comments.ExportLicenseInventory: Default true. Set to false to skip the Microsoft 365 license inventory export.
_comments.Permissions: Defender plans need Reader or Security Reader on the subscriptions. The license inventory needs directory read access (e.g. Microsoft Entra Global Reader or Directory.Read.All). Each export is best-effort and independent - if one is not permitted, the other still runs.
